c.tagline: Cyberpunk mountain metropolis of fog, hot pot, and cities stacked along the Yangtze.

taxi.fareNote: Meters are standard with a starting fare around 10 yuan; many drivers prefer cash or a WeChat/Alipay QR code, and few speak English, so have your destination written in Chinese.

emergency.note: 110 connects to police, 120 for ambulance, and 119 for fire. English support is limited, so use a translation app or ask hotel staff to help place the call.

hood_landmark.Nanshan (Nan'an): Nanshan One Tree Viewing Platform, Chongqing

avoid.reason: Watch for pickpockets in the crowded Jiefangbei and Hongyadong areas and on packed metro lines, and skip unlicensed taxis at stations.

hood_desc: The dense downtown peninsula between the Yangtze and Jialing rivers, centered on the Jiefangbei (Liberation Monument) pedestrian mall and the stacked Hongyadong stilt houses; best for first-timers who want everything within walking distance.

A major commercial and nightlife hub on the north bank across the Jialing, packed with malls, bars, and restaurants and adjacent to the gleaming Jiangbeizui financial district; ideal for shopping and going out.
A forested mountain on the south bank famous for its cluster of hot pot restaurants, the One Tree lookout, and sweeping night views of the illuminated skyline; quieter, greener, and scenic.
A lively university and youth district around Sanxia Square and the Testbed2 creative park, with cheap eats, indie shops, and quick access to Ciqikou; affordable and full of student energy.
A 1,000-year-old riverside porcelain town of cobbled lanes, teahouses, and street-food stalls near the Jialing River; touristy but atmospheric, best for old-town wandering and souvenirs.

water.note: Tap water is treated for household use but not recommended for drinking; use bottled water.

transit.hours: Trains run roughly 6:30 AM to 10:30-11:00 PM depending on the line.
transit.note: Chongqing Rail Transit is an extensive metro network famous for its straddle-beam monorail Lines 2 and 3 — Line 2 threads directly through the Liziba station built into a residential tower, and the system climbs the mountainous terrain with dramatic elevation changes, bridges, and cliffside stations.
transit.pay: Pay by QR code through Alipay/WeChat or the Yu Kuai Xing app, a rechargeable Chang'an Tong transit card, or single-journey tokens from station machines (fares run ~2-10 yuan by distance).

bus: Long-distance coaches from Chongqing Coach Station and Longtousi Bus Station

car.idp: Not valid — China does not recognize the IDP; visitors need a temporary Chinese licence, so most do not self-drive

ferry: Yangtze River cross-river passenger ferries and cruise piers at Chaotianmen
train: Chongqingbei (North), Chongqingxi (West) & Shapingba high-speed rail stations
High-speed links to Chengdu, Xi'an, Wuhan, Guiyang and beyond

transit.m: Rail Transit Line 3/10 to city center (~45-60 min)
Taxi to Jiefangbei city center (40-55 min)
Airport shuttle bus to downtown (~50 min)

tip.r: Tipping is not expected or practiced in restaurants, taxis, or hotels; a service charge is occasionally added at upscale venues.
